tasks.short: Calculate materials, agency charges and overhead costs for our three sites.

today.trigger: A site requests a cost estimate, a supplier changes prices, or Finance needs an updated cost schedule.
steps: Collect quotations, price lists, estimated quantities and approved allocation rules.
Find comparable costs and supplier details in AFAS.
Calculate quantities, rates, discounts and overhead allocations in Excel.
Check unusual movements and send the calculation with its assumptions.
drudgery: Copying rates from quotations into spreadsheets
Repeating the same allocation calculations for three sites
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 40 hours per FTE annually. The assumed workflow loses time finding current rates, correcting units and rebuilding calculations; actual practice needs confirmation.

lenses.faster: Approved rate tables and fixed formulas remove repeated typing, lookups and arithmetic; quotation extraction produces a proposal for checking.
lenses.autonomous: An approved rate or quantity update recalculates affected schedules and flags missing inputs or expired prices.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain current cost estimates for each site and compare agency invoices with agreed rates before differences accumulate.
lenses.joy: Spend less time copying price lists and more time explaining why a cost changed.
lenses.options: Compare current and alternative suppliers, volumes and overhead assumptions using the same calculation rules.
lenses.altitude: Own the rate register, allocation rules and checks that make cost calculations reliable.
reach: Prepare cost bridges for the FP&A Analyst.
Prepare supplier price comparisons for purchasing and site managers.

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether quantities and allocation drivers reflect warehouse operations, and challenge unsupported assumptions with site managers.
tasks.pattern_why: Rates, quantities and approved allocation rules support checkable arithmetic. An optional llm_step extracts unfamiliar quotations into a proposed rate table; a person verifies them before use.

in_practice.trigger: An approved price list, quantity estimate or allocation rule changes.
steps: Import structured rates and quantities; extract unstructured quotations into a separate review queue.
Validate supplier, currency, unit, effective date and source document.
Calculate costs with versioned formulas and approved allocation drivers.
Publish routine schedules and route missing inputs or large movements to the bookkeeper.
Save the calculation, assumptions and comparison with the previous version.
in_practice.human_gate: A person approves extracted rates, new allocation methods and material assumption changes before they enter automatic calculations; managers retain spending authority.
systems: Excel Power Query and controlled formulas
Approved document extraction service, if needed
data_needed: Supplier quotations and price lists with effective dates
Estimated quantities and units
Approved overhead allocation drivers
Agency contract rates and authorised surcharge tables
AFAS ledger and site mappings
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint calculation register containing source links, rate versions, formula versions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Power Query can combine consistently structured files, supporting repeatable rate-table preparation; it does not establish Noordhaven's allocation rules.
A 50% labour saving and twofold end-to-end speedup are planning estimates for this proposed workflow, not measured results.

risks: Wrong units, obsolete rates or omitted surcharges produce precise but incorrect totals.
An agency's charge rate must not be confused with employee pay or a CAO entitlement.
An allocation change can shift reported site profitability without changing total company costs.
research_questions: What share of requests uses repeatable quantities, rates and allocation rules?
Can supplier and agency rates be obtained in structured files with effective dates?
Who approves allocation drivers, and which changes require Controller review?
Does a sample of completed calculations reproduce exactly from the proposed rules?

tasks.short: Match Rabobank transactions to AFAS invoices and explain the remaining differences.

today.trigger: A new Rabobank statement arrives or the month-close bank reconciliation is due.
steps: Import or retrieve bank statements and confirm all accounts and dates are covered.
Run existing AFAS matching against outstanding invoices.
Investigate unmatched receipts, payments, fees and transfers.
Record approved corrections and reconcile statement balances to the ledger.
drudgery: Repeating checks on recurring bank fees
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 39 hours per FTE annually. Unclear references and grouped payments are the assumed main delays; existing AFAS matching coverage must be measured.

lenses.faster: Improve AFAS matching rules and automatically build the reconciliation, leaving only unresolved transactions to inspect.
lenses.autonomous: Each imported statement runs through approved matching rules, completeness checks and an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Keep every bank account reconciled daily so close starts with fewer unknown cash movements.
lenses.joy: Replace reference hunting with solving the few transactions that actually need investigation.
lenses.options: For unmatched receipts, show several candidate invoices with amounts, references and reasons; never settle an ambiguous match automatically.
lenses.altitude: Own matching rules, tolerances and the ageing of unresolved bank differences.
reach: Resolve receipt-allocation issues with the Credit and Collections Officer.
Provide reconciled cash inputs to the FP&A Analyst.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve disputed allocations, recognise suspicious transactions and decide whether a difference needs escalation.
tasks.pattern_why: AFAS already matches structured bank lines using references and amounts. An optional llm_step can summarise evidence for unmatched lines, but matching and reconciliation remain rule-based.

in_practice.trigger: A complete new Rabobank statement is imported into AFAS.
steps: Check statement identity, sequence, opening balance and duplicate imports.
Apply approved AFAS matching rules, initially limited to unambiguous matches with zero tolerance.
Check closing bank balances against ledger balances and identify unreconciled items.
Present ambiguous matches with supporting invoices and remittance information.
Record resolutions and track remaining differences by age and owner.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves ambiguous allocations and approves exception postings; an Accountant reviews the month-end reconciliation. This workflow grants no payment-release authority.
systems: Rabobank statement export or existing bank connection
data_needed: Complete bank statements for every relevant account
AFAS open items and bank ledger entries
Payment references and remittance advice
Approved matching rules and tolerances
Previous unresolved differences
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS transaction history plus a SharePoint reconciliation record showing statement coverage, rule versions, exceptions and reviewer sign-off.

evidence.claim: AFAS documents automatic bank matching using payment references, IBANs, invoice numbers and amount rules, with manual handling where matching fails.
A 60% labour saving and 2.5-fold end-to-end speedup depend on improving the current match rate; neither is a measured Noordhaven result.

risks: A plausible reference or oldest-first allocation can settle the wrong invoice.
Missing or duplicated statements can make an incomplete reconciliation appear finished.
Broad tolerances can hide repeated small discrepancies.
research_questions: What percentage of bank lines already matches without a person touching them?
Which unmatched categories account for most investigation time?
Can every account's statement completeness and balance continuity be checked automatically?
Do proposed rules reproduce reviewed historical matches without false allocations?

tasks.short: Prepare cash, payables, receivables and ledger reports for Finance.

today.trigger: The reporting calendar reaches a deadline or a manager requests an updated financial table.
steps: Retrieve AFAS reports and the latest Power BI extract.
Check periods, site mappings, refresh times and report totals.
Combine tables and format the requested report in Excel.
Explain notable differences and circulate the checked version.
drudgery: Copying the same totals into different templates
Reconciling reports with different dates or filters
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 33.8 hours per FTE annually. Repeated extracts and inconsistent report definitions are assumed sources of rework; Power BI already provides some reporting.

lenses.faster: Refresh controlled report templates from one checked dataset, removing manual copying and routine formatting.
lenses.autonomous: After the nightly AFAS extract passes checks, generate standard tables with a visible data timestamp.
lenses.ambitious: Give each site a consistent weekly view of overdue balances, cash movements and unresolved accounting items.
lenses.joy: Spend reporting time answering useful questions instead of aligning columns.
lenses.options: Offer views by site, customer, supplier and ageing band without maintaining separate workbooks.
lenses.altitude: Own definitions, source-to-report checks and the quality of the financial information people use.
reach: Prepare standard reporting inputs for the Controller.
Maintain receivables exception views for the Credit and Collections Officer.

tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a meaningful business movement from a timing effect, missing posting or misleading comparison.
tasks.pattern_why: Aggregation, reconciliations and report layouts are repeatable and checkable. An optional llm_step drafts commentary from verified figures, with human review before circulation.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract completes successfully or a scheduled reporting date arrives.
steps: Check extract completion, freshness, row counts and control totals.
Calculate approved measures using consistent periods and site mappings.
Generate standard tables with source links and refresh timestamps.
Flag material movements and optionally draft evidence-linked commentary.
Publish standard checked tables and route failed checks or new commentary for review.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller approves report definitions and formal close-pack release; the bookkeeper checks new narrative and exceptions. Failed controls block automatic publication.
systems: Approved language model for optional commentary
data_needed: AFAS ledger and open-item extracts
Approved report and metric definitions
Site and account mappings
Reporting calendar and materiality thresholds
Previous-period figures and extract timestamps
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint report archive with dataset version, parameters, control results, narrative approvals and publication time.

evidence.claim: AFAS provides financial reports and control lists; its guidance also identifies different date bases that can explain apparent report discrepancies.
Power Query combines files with a consistent structure, supporting repeatable report preparation.
A 60% labour saving and 2.5-fold end-to-end speedup are estimates for remaining manual report preparation, not gains already delivered by Power BI.

risks: Nightly Power BI data can be mistaken for current AFAS balances.
Inconsistent posting-date and invoice-date filters create false differences.
Generated commentary can invent causes that the figures do not establish.
Reports can expose personal or commercially sensitive information through overly broad access.
research_questions: Which reports still require manual work after the existing Power BI refresh?
Can each reported total be reconciled to AFAS using agreed dates and filters?
Which reports genuinely need same-day data?
Will Finance accept automatically published standard tables when all controls pass?

tasks.short: Prepare and check the trial balance before the Accountant reviews month close.

today.trigger: A month-close checkpoint or an Accountant's review requires an updated trial balance.
steps: Run the AFAS trial balance for the required administration and period.
Compare opening balances, movements and closing balances.
Reconcile payables, receivables and bank control accounts using matching date bases.
Investigate unusual balances and give the Accountant a checked schedule with unresolved items.
drudgery: Exporting and formatting a report AFAS already calculates
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 32.4 hours per FTE annually. The assumed opportunity is in checks, evidence and reruns; AFAS already produces the trial balance.

lenses.faster: Automate supporting reconciliations and exception schedules around the existing AFAS trial balance.
lenses.autonomous: At each close checkpoint, rerun the checks and flag changes since the last reviewed version.
lenses.ambitious: Run selected balance checks throughout the month so problems surface before close.
lenses.joy: Replace repeated exports with investigating balances that deserve attention.
lenses.options: Compare current balances with prior month, prior year and expected account behaviour using explicit thresholds.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a close-control system that shows which balances are supported and which need work.
reach: Prepare supporting schedules currently assembled by the Accountant.
Maintain the Controller's unresolved close-items register.

tasks.human_edge: Judge accounting substance, completeness and materiality; a balanced ledger alone does not establish that the accounts are correct.
tasks.pattern_why: Trial-balance generation and specified reconciliations use structured records and fixed tests. Accounting corrections and explanations remain subject to review.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled close checkpoint occurs or new postings change a previously checked period.
steps: Capture the AFAS trial balance with administration, period and extraction timestamp.
Run opening-balance, movement and control-account reconciliations using consistent posting dates.
Apply approved checks for unusual signs, dormant accounts and material movements.
Build an exception schedule with links to transactions and supporting documents.
Rerun after approved corrections and record changes since the reviewed version.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper investigates exceptions; the Accountant approves correction journals and accepts the reconciliation package. Automatic checks cannot authorise close or establish completeness alone.
systems: AFAS Profit trial balance and control reports
Excel Power Query or a controlled reconciliation script
data_needed: Period-specific ledger balances and movements
Posting-date-based payables and receivables control reports
Bank reconciliations
Approved account checks and materiality thresholds
Prior reviewed versions and supporting schedules
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint close-control register with AFAS references, test results, exception owners, journal approvals and version sign-off.

evidence.claim: AFAS already provides trial balances, period comparisons and drill-down to transactions and attached invoices.
AFAS explains that open-item reports and trial balances can use different date bases and identifies control reports using posting dates.
A 45% labour saving and approximately 1.82-fold end-to-end speedup are estimates for surrounding preparation and checking.

risks: Debit-credit equality can conceal omitted accruals, misclassification or duplicate postings.
Late postings can invalidate a previously reviewed package.
Poor thresholds can create excessive alerts or miss material errors.
research_questions: How much of the 32.4-hour baseline is export work versus accounting investigation?
Which recurring close differences can be expressed as reliable tests?
Can every source report use the same administration, period and posting-date basis?
Does replaying the checks identify known historical close errors without excessive false alerts?

tasks.short: Assemble checked budget inputs for FP&A across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.

today.trigger: FP&A starts a budget or forecast round and requests actuals, commitments and site estimates.
steps: Retrieve previous budgets and AFAS actuals.
Collect site estimates, supplier commitments and approved payroll cost assumptions.
Map inputs to common accounts, sites and periods in Excel.
Check missing inputs and reconcile totals before handing the pack to FP&A.
drudgery: Re-entering estimates in a common template
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 29.2 hours per FTE annually. Assumed delays concern consolidation, missing submissions and changing versions; forecast judgement belongs to FP&A.

lenses.faster: Load actuals, previous budgets and standard submissions into one mapped input table, removing copy-and-paste consolidation.
lenses.autonomous: Each new submission is validated and added to a draft pack; missing fields and conflicting versions enter an exception list.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a monthly rolling input pack with visible commitments and seasonal agency-cost drivers.
lenses.joy: Spend less time repairing spreadsheets and more time helping sites explain their assumptions.
lenses.options: Calculate base, peak-season and lower-volume cases from assumptions approved by FP&A.
lenses.altitude: Own the completeness, consistency and traceability of budget inputs.
reach: Prepare actual-to-budget bridges for the FP&A Analyst.
Maintain a structured commitments schedule for the Controller.

tasks.human_edge: Challenge unsupported estimates and distinguish an approved business assumption from a convenient extrapolation.
tasks.pattern_why: Collection, mapping, consolidation and scenario arithmetic follow fixed rules. A copilot can summarise submissions, but FP&A and budget owners retain assumptions and forecast approval.

in_practice.trigger: FP&A opens a forecast round or a site submits revised budget inputs.
steps: Load AFAS actuals and the approved previous budget using controlled account and site mappings.
Import standard site submissions and flag missing fields, duplicates and conflicting versions.
Add approved commitments, agency-rate assumptions and aggregated payroll cost inputs.
Calculate requested scenarios and changes from the previous version.
Present a reconciled draft pack with source links and unresolved assumptions for approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper checks each consolidated pack; site owners approve their inputs and FP&A approves scenarios and any budget import.
systems: AFAS Profit exports and budget import, if configured
Excel Power Query and scenario formulas
data_needed: AFAS actuals and previous approved budgets
Account, site and period mappings
Site volume estimates and commitments
Approved seasonal agency assumptions
Aggregated payroll assumptions supplied by Payroll or Compensation and Benefits
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint budget-input register containing submission versions, validation results, assumption owners and approval history.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports budget scenarios and budget imports; these capabilities do not supply business assumptions or guarantee forecast accuracy.
A 50% labour saving and twofold end-to-end speedup are estimates for compiling the input pack, excluding delays waiting for business decisions.

risks: Automated consolidation can propagate stale assumptions across every scenario.
CAO pay changes and agency surcharges can be applied in the wrong period or counted twice.
Detailed employee payroll records could be exposed when aggregate cost assumptions would suffice.
An AFAS preferred-scenario setting can direct imported budgets to an unintended scenario.
research_questions: Can all three sites submit the same minimum budget-input structure?
Which inputs are approved commitments and which are estimates?
Who supplies and approves CAO-related payroll and agency-cost assumptions?
How much forecast-round time is active compilation versus waiting for submissions?

tasks.short: Keep financial stock records aligned with site movements and approved counts.

today.trigger: A site supplies stock movements, a count identifies a difference, or month close needs a stock reconciliation.
steps: Obtain site stock records and identify which goods Noordhaven owns.
Check receipts, issues, transfers and count adjustments against supporting documents.
Update the financial stock schedule and compare it with AFAS balances.
Investigate differences with the site and obtain approval for corrections.
systems: Site stock records, source system to be confirmed
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 21.7 hours per FTE annually. No warehouse management system is specified, so the stock source, ownership boundaries and present workflow remain assumptions.

lenses.faster: Import standard movement files and reconcile quantities and values automatically, leaving unmatched records for investigation.
lenses.autonomous: Each validated site file updates a proposed stock schedule and flags duplicate movements, missing transfers and count differences.
lenses.ambitious: Check owned-stock movements frequently enough to find discrepancies before month-end counts.
lenses.joy: Replace file stitching with resolving physical and financial differences alongside warehouse colleagues.
lenses.options: Show whether a difference could be a timing issue, unit mismatch, missing transfer or count adjustment, with evidence for each possibility.
lenses.altitude: Own the reconciliation between operational stock records and financial balances.
reach: Prepare inventory reconciliation schedules for the Accountant.
Maintain stock-data exception lists for site administration.

tasks.human_edge: Establish ownership, verify physical evidence with warehouse staff and assess whether losses or valuation issues need escalation.
tasks.pattern_why: Movement validation and quantity-value reconciliations use explicit rules. Physical existence, ownership and adjustments require human evidence and approval.

in_practice.trigger: A site submits an authorised movement file or count result.
steps: Validate file completeness, item codes, units, movement identifiers and ownership category.
Calculate opening stock plus receipts minus issues and reconcile paired transfers.
Compare proposed closing quantities and approved valuations with stock schedules and AFAS.
Build an exception list linked to movement documents and count evidence.
Apply approved schedule changes and submit any financial adjustment through the normal journal workflow.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each update batch; site managers confirm physical differences and the Accountant approves valuation changes and ledger adjustments.
systems: Authorised site stock exports, once identified
Excel Power Query and reconciliation formulas
data_needed: Owned-stock item master and unit conversions
Opening balances and complete movement records
Transfer identifiers and receiving confirmations
Approved count sheets and valuation rules
Clear separation of customer-owned and Noordhaven-owned goods
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint stock-reconciliation register with file versions, movement identifiers, count evidence and approval references.

evidence.claim: Power Query can consolidate consistently structured files; this supports a possible import layer, not an assumed AFAS warehouse integration.
Rule-based movement reconciliation is plausible when complete records and consistent item identifiers exist.
A 35% labour saving and approximately 1.54-fold end-to-end speedup are speculative until the stock source and ownership scope are confirmed.

risks: Customer-owned warehouse goods could be incorrectly recorded as Noordhaven assets.
Incomplete movements or inconsistent units can create false stock differences.
Automatic records cannot establish physical existence or justify a write-off.
research_questions: Which inventory does Noordhaven actually own, and what stock records does this role maintain?
Which system records movements at each site, and can it export complete identifiable transactions?
Are item codes, units and transfer identifiers consistent across sites?
How much effort concerns record maintenance versus physical counts and ownership disputes?

tasks.short: Prepare VAT returns and supporting schedules, and supply checked figures for payroll and pension filings.

today.trigger: A Dutch filing deadline approaches or a correction is needed.
steps: Confirm the required return, period, responsible owner and deadline.
Collect AFAS balances and supporting invoice or payroll schedules.
Reconcile amounts and investigate unusual tax codes or movements.
Prepare the return or supporting pack for the Accountant or Payroll Specialist.
After authorisation, submit within assigned authority and retain the receipt and payment reference.
today.time_sinks: Input baseline: 19.5 hours per FTE annually. The Dutch scope is assumed to centre on VAT and supporting schedules; US-style workers' compensation forms are not assumed.

lenses.faster: Populate draft returns from reconciled AFAS totals and assemble supporting evidence automatically.
lenses.autonomous: The filing calendar starts preparation, runs completeness checks and tracks acknowledgements after authorised submission.
lenses.ambitious: Run tax-code and reconciliation checks during the period so filing week contains fewer surprises.
lenses.joy: Remove transcription and receipt hunting while retaining investigation of unusual transactions.
lenses.options: Present alternative treatments for genuinely uncertain items with the relevant evidence and an explicit question for the Accountant.
lenses.altitude: Own the filing evidence and control calendar while specialists retain tax and payroll decisions.
reach: Prepare VAT reconciliation and correction schedules for the Accountant.
Provide reconciled ledger totals to the Payroll Specialist for payroll and pension checks.

tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty, obtain specialist interpretation and ensure the authorised filer understands what is being submitted.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved tax mappings, reconciliations, form population and acknowledgement tracking are checkable rules. A language model may explain exceptions but must not determine uncertain tax treatment or independently submit returns.

in_practice.trigger: The filing calendar reaches a preparation checkpoint or an approved correction request is logged.
steps: Identify the filing obligation, current form version, period and authorised reviewer.
Extract AFAS totals and apply approved mappings and reconciliation tests.
Produce a draft return with source-linked schedules and unresolved exceptions.
Route VAT questions to the Accountant and payroll or pension questions to the Payroll Specialist.
After explicit approval, submit through the supported authorised channel and retain the acknowledgement.
Track rejection messages, corrections and the separate payment instruction to completion.
in_practice.human_gate: The authorised Accountant or Payroll Specialist approves each filing and any uncertain treatment before submission. Payment release follows Noordhaven's separate bank approval process.
systems: Supported accounting-software filing channel or Mijn Belastingdienst Zakelijk
data_needed: Confirmed filing obligations and delegated authorities
AFAS tax-code balances and supporting transactions
Current approved tax mappings and form specifications
Payroll and pension totals supplied by the Payroll Specialist
Previous filings, corrections and submission acknowledgements
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint filing register containing reconciliations, approved return versions, reviewer identity, submission acknowledgements and payment references.

evidence.claim: The Belastingdienst supports VAT filing through Mijn Belastingdienst Zakelijk, accounting software or a tax service provider.
AFAS lists VAT-return checking among its financial control activities; the proposed approval and evidence workflow still needs configuration.
A 40% labour saving and approximately 1.67-fold end-to-end speedup are estimates, with specialist review retained.

risks: An incorrect tax mapping can repeat the same error across every filing.
A technically successful submission can still contain incorrect figures; a missing acknowledgement can leave filing status uncertain.
Payroll or pension inputs can be duplicated across Finance and Payroll ownership boundaries.
Filing credentials and employee-level data require restricted access and approved processing arrangements.
research_questions: Which filings does the bookkeeper actually prepare or submit, and who legally and operationally authorises them?
Which AFAS filing channels are configured and supported for Noordhaven?
Can previous returns be reproduced exactly from approved mappings and reconciled source data?
Which exceptions caused corrections or specialist intervention in the last year?

role.altitude: From entering and assembling financial records to owning the rules, reconciliations and evidence that keep payables, receivables and close inputs dependable.
reach: Prepare routine close schedules and supporting evidence for the Accountant.
Maintain cash-allocation and overdue-balance exception views with the Credit and Collections Officer.
Assemble checked actuals, commitments and scenario inputs for FP&A.
Maintain supplier-rate and agency-invoice exception schedules with site managers.
Improve financial source-data checks with the owner of the AFAS extract and Power BI dashboards.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks cover 215.6 hours per FTE annually, about 13.5% of a 1,600-hour role. The estimates release about 108 hours per FTE, or 325 hours across three FTE: roughly EUR 14,600 of gross annual capacity at EUR 45/hour, before implementation and running costs. They do not justify extrapolation to the whole role or a headcount reduction. Current workflows are inferred, existing AFAS and Power BI automation must be credited, and stock-system availability is unresolved. Speedups describe active task execution including review, not waiting for sites, nightly refreshes or specialist decisions.
skills_to_grow: Configure and test AFAS matching, reporting and reconciliation rules.
Build maintainable Power Query transformations and controlled Excel calculations.
Measure exception rates, false matches, rework and actual time saved.
Maintain source links, rule versions and approval evidence.
Investigate accounting differences and explain them clearly to site managers.
Use document extraction with field checks and human verification.
Handle personal data minimally in approved environments and recognise when a proposed use expands into employee decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Run a daily financial exception service across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo: reconcile cash, check agency charges, surface missing cost inputs and keep close evidence ready. Measure success through fewer unresolved differences, more invoices processed without touch, fewer audit adjustments and earlier delivery of checked actuals to FP&A. Start with a baseline and a limited pilot; expand only where reviewed outputs remain correct and the time released improves close or forecast inputs.
